note: London is framed week on week and year on year rather than against target: the target columns are carried for reference only, read from the FY26/27 portfolio workbook, which prorates this cross-month week itself (six days of October and one of November) and lifts Hutong, Azzurra and DSL above their standing weekly figures. DSL stays flagged not comparable because it trades against a pre-rebrand base of nothing at all: its entire 2025 side is a verified zero in both GA4 and SevenRooms. GA4 bookings are the create path only, so /modify/, /manage/ and /prearrival/ events are excluded; this week, the prior week and last year are all rebuilt on that basis and compare cleanly with each other but not with any week published before 12 October 2026. Amendments were 7.2 per cent of London volume this week against 10.5 per cent in the matched 2025 week, so the old basis would have read 2,666 against 3,130, a year-on-year fall of 14.8 per cent rather than 11.7. London booked 2,474 create-path GA4 bookings, down 11.7 per cent year on year and up 0.7 per cent week on week; ex DSL the year-on-year figure is down 20.4 per cent. Four of the six venues are still under-recording and their GA4 figures are floors, not readings. Against SevenRooms website bookings for the same days, Aqua Shard tracks at 1.01 and Hutong at 1.09, both sound, but Regent St reads 0.61, Azzurra 0.61, Shiro Sushi 0.62 and DSL 0.55 against a clean baseline of 0.96 to 0.99. All four improved slightly on last week, Shiro Sushi most of all from 0.38, but none is fixed and the fault is now eighteen days old. Covers are reported alongside because total_payment is unreliable in London and GA4 cannot see OpenTable: on covers the week was the strongest of the eight on record.
